Two different years, not one trend

AP credit has doubled

All colleges — the summary sheet’s Fall 2026 column. It counts course credits granted, one per student per exam per BU course. Nine in ten exams credit one course, so 16,223 credits came from 14,273 exams; the gap is calculus and biology, where one exam credits several courses (eg, a Calculus BC exam credits MATH 224, 225, 226 and an elective).

Each student brings more of it

All colleges. The entering cohort has been relatively stable in size — the left panel is a rising share arriving with credit, not a bigger university. Students with no AP credit are not in these data.

What students are getting credit for

HUM humanities elective, SOCS social science elective, MSCI math/science elective, LART liberal arts elective. All four are Harpur requirements.
